bug: A new erase_recipient function was pasted between the 'async def _ensure_recruitment_allowed(' line and its parameter list, so results/service.py is a syntax error and the module (and the API that imports it) cannot load.

publish_platform_station_version passes an extra actor=admin keyword to service_versions.publish_version, which does not accept it, so publishing a platform station raises TypeError and returns a 500.

my_sittings now drops every slot whose org is not in the JWT's membership map even with no org_slug, so a rostered trainee whose token was minted before the roster entry (or before membership was granted) sees none of their sittings in the all-workspaces view.

revoked_org_ids_for_user treats an org as revoked if ANY of the person's roster entries has access_revoked_at set, so someone with one revoked and one live entry in an org loses all that org's sittings; the 'revoked' rule differs between this and is_revoked.

Worker bootstrap calls ensure_entitled_to_begin, which raises NotEntitled, but the attempt is left in 'created' and the 403 error path rolls back, so the worker retries into the same refusal forever and the attempt never reaches a failed state.

restore_payment (won dispute) restores any revoked grant, including one support revoked for abuse or a recorded refund, and credits back a refunded payment; referral counts also include clawback rows as extra referrals.

The email-change token is bound only to the old and new address, not to password state, so a link mailed before a password reset (e.g. by a hijacked session) still moves the account; a concurrent confirmation also hits an unhandled IntegrityError (500).
entitled_exam_ids returns exam_id for every grant ever held, never checking live, so revoked or expired subscribers are treated as entitled and can be offered and read paid material by the tutor.

SAML sign-in trusts responses lacking InResponseTo or audience and does not make AuthnRequests or hand-off tokens single-use (replayable), and keys the subject by NameID alone across orgs, so an IdP could sign someone into another tenant's account.

SSO sign-in wipes the account password whenever the audit log shows it began as a relayed temporary password and this is the first sign-in with that provider, so linking a second provider destroys a password the owner chose since.

SSO sign-in only drops a password when must_change_password is still set, so an admin who seated an address with a temporary password, then signed in and changed it, keeps a working password and a way in after the real owner arrives via SSO.
The organisation setup checklist counts published rubrics, exams and templates visible_to the org, which includes the platform's rows, so steps show as done for an organisation that has done nothing.
stripe_refund asks Stripe for a refund without locking the payment or checking it was already withdrawn, refunded or disputed, so a second click or stale console refunds twice.
cancel_job only records that marking gave up for a stalled running scoring job, not a waiting one, so cancelling a waiting scoring job leaves the attempt waiting for marking forever.
withdraw_payment returns early as soon as the grant is already revoked, so a grant revoked by hand lets a later refund or dispute skip the referral credit clawback.
is_open only checks now >= starts_at - 10 minutes, with no upper bound and no status check, so a cancelled, completed or hours-old peer session can still be joined.
